SOURCE: The Canadian Almanac and Directory, 1917 and 1918 editions,
        table 'POST OFFICES AND RAILROAD STATIONS IN CANADA'.
        Internet Archive items canadianalmanacd0000unse_y6g6 (1917) and _x3a0 (1918).
        Edition years read from the running headers ('1917]' and '1918]'), because the Archive's
        metadata gives 1848, the series start date, for both.
        Full djvu text downloaded and searched 2026-09-06; only these lines were read out.

NOT RECORDED: the columns beside the name -- the railroad on which located, or the nearest
railway station. The OCR breaks this table into separate column runs and the rows cannot be
aligned to their values with any confidence. The 1915 Post Office report's mail-route line
'Kanawana -- St. Sauveur des Mont[s]' is the reliable statement of the connection.
